title: Edges in a Complete Graph
problem: How many edges does the complete graph K_5 have?

title: Chromatic Number of K_4
problem: What is the chromatic number of the complete graph K_4?
hint: Every pair of vertices is adjacent.
walkthrough: In K_n, every two vertices are adjacent.
So all vertices need distinct colors: chi(K_4) = 4.

title: Handshake Lemma
problem: A graph has 6 edges. What is the sum of the degrees of all its vertices?
hint: Each edge contributes 2 to the degree sum.
walkthrough: Handshake lemma: sum of degrees = 2 * (number of edges).

title: Spanning Trees of K_4
problem: By Cayley's formula, how many distinct labelled spanning trees does K_4 have?
walkthrough: Cayley's formula: number of spanning trees of K_n is n^(n-2).
